desc:
🚪 Welcome to Save Your Friend! 🚪

😨 For some reason your friend has been taken
🧠 You don't know why, but you will SAVE THEM at all costs
🔑 Beat the Evil Bacon's traps to find out what your friend did

⭐ 450 LEVELS - minigames, puzzles, secret codes and trick rooms
👑 4 BOSS FIGHTS - can you beat King Bacon?
🔥 HARD MODE - 220 levels again, for true pros
🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT - 30 spooky levels and a boss, only here for a short time!

🥚 PETS! Earn gems from levels and hatch 75+ pets
🐾 Pets boost your gems & wins - collect them all in the Pet Index!
💎 GEM SHOPS - Bacon skins, trails and titles, new stock every day

❗ You can change your friend in settings ❗

🎉 Join the group for Auto Hatch!
🛠️ Let us know in the group if you come across bugs

👍 Like and favourite the game to support future updates, including more levels and the TRUTH...
